mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and decreases in unemployment rate signal an overheating economy where monetary policy tightening accelerates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor markets drive wage inflation and force premature Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) indicates robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1150 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, reducing retail and construction sector earnings, and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1150 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized < 2.0%) signals an economic deceleration phase that reduces corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth is below 2.0%.
